notes: Sports: every theDaddy channel for a match is now a separate backup source • Sports: HD routes stay ahead of soft cuts and a dead 1080p route falls back to a 720p theDaddy feed • Sports: a failed feed is re-probed after 30 s, then 1, 2 and 3 minutes instead of being written off • Sports: backup failover picks the best working feed in either direction • Sports picker: whole match posters in 16:9 tiles with no cropping • Sports picker: rows show the live quarter/clock and score, refreshed every 15 s • Home: opening a live match now gives the same sport shortlist as the Sports page • Sports: non-English theDaddy feeds are filtered out while an English feed is listed
